pages.text: Strawberries are harvested from fully grown Strawberry Crops.$(br2)Obtain Strawberry Seeds and plant them on farmland to grow the crop.
Plant Strawberry Seeds on farmland. A fully grown crop produces 1 Strawberry and 2 Strawberry Seeds when harvested.
Strawberries are edible and are used in several recipes, including Strawberry Jam, Strawberry Smoothies and Strawberry Ice Cream.
